reports.title: Kohl’s Reports Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Financial Outlook
section: Based on the updated full year outlook, The Company expects the following GAAP outlook for the fourth quarter:
• | Net sales and Comparable sales: In the range of flat to up 2.0%
• | Operating margin: In the range of 4.0% to 4.4% which includes the benefit of:
• | Diluted EPS: In the range of $0.95 to $1.15 which includes the benefit of:

desk.headline: Net sales up 1.3% to $3.45bn, comps +1.2% and adjusted EPS of $1.76, above estimates; full-year outlook raised

other.label: Gross margin
other.change: +145 bps y/y, ~130 bps from tariff refunds

other.label: Cash
other.change: vs $144m a year ago, no revolver borrowings

results: Net sales rose 1.3% to $3.45bn with comparable sales up 1.2%, slightly above the $3.44bn estimate; stores grew while digital slipped.
Adjusted EPS was $1.76 against $0.10 a year ago; GAAP EPS of $2.15 was lifted by a $137m tax benefit ($1.16) and a $61m real-estate gain ($0.39).
Gross margin improved 145 bps to 41.0%, of which about 130 bps came from $45m of tariff refunds; higher fuel costs were a partial offset.
SG&A rose 1.2% to $1.28bn on store payroll and media spending; inventory was 1% lower at $3.85bn.
Kohl's bought back $39m of shares in the quarter and has cut long-term debt to $1.33bn from $1.52bn a year ago.

guidance.summary: Full-year sales guidance moved up to flat to +0.5% (was a 1.5% decline to flat), and EPS is now given on a GAAP basis at $4.30–4.50, which includes the tax benefit, tariff refunds and the property gain. Q4 calls for flat to +2% comps and EPS of $0.95–1.15.

points: CEO Michael Bender called the quarter a return to sales growth but said more work is needed, noting stores up 2% and digital down 1%.
Every major category was positive: footwear returned to growth (+4%), proprietary brands rose 3.4% and marketplace sales grew about 75%.
Management said core shoppers face rising daily costs and are moving toward value, with some higher-income customers trading in.
A warm start to November slowed cold-weather categories; the CFO flagged a promotional holiday, higher SG&A and rising fuel and freight costs in Q4.
Kohl's still plans up to $100m of buybacks in 2026 and is eyeing its 2030 notes, which become callable in June 2027.
call.source: Prepared presentation (Exhibit 99.2); call coverage: The Motley Fool transcript, 24 Nov 2026; MarketBeat via Yahoo Finance, 24 Nov 2026

watch: Whether positive comps hold through the holiday quarter as tariff-refund help fades.
Q4 gross margin under heavier promotions and higher fuel and freight costs.
Digital sales trend, which is still declining while stores grow.
